figures.finding: Germany's 2026 income tax is a formula tariff: nothing up to the €12,348 basic allowance, a rising rate from 14% to about 24% up to €17,799 and on to 42% at €69,879, 42% to €277,825 and 45% above; married couples filing jointly pay twice the tax on half their joint income. A 5.5% solidarity surcharge is added only where the income tax exceeds €20,350 (€40,700 joint).

figures.finding: An employee and the employer each pay half of pension insurance 18.6%, unemployment 2.6%, health 14.6% plus the fund's additional rate (average 2.9%) and long-term care 3.6% (employee +0.6% if childless); pension and unemployment stop at €101,400 a year, health and care at €69,750. A self-employed artist or writer in the Künstlersozialkasse pays only the employee half on estimated annual income, the KSK covering the rest from the hirers' 4.9% levy (5.0% in 2027) and a federal grant.
